mapper.sql: WHERE 1=1 AND INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.efficacy, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.usage_dosage, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.entp_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.class_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.etc_otc_code, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 (INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.material_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(m.item_name, '\([^)]*\)'), '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0) (INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.medication_id, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.edi_code, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0) 1=0 AND m.is_discontinued = 0 AND m.is_discontinued = 1 AND m.medication_id IN (SELECT medication_id FROM dur_matches)

WHERE d.taboo_type IN (1,2,3,4)
AND (INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(d.ingr_a_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 OR (d.taboo_type=4 AND INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(d.ingr_b_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0)) INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(d.taboo_effect, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{f.value}) > 0 1=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.medication_id AS "itemSeq", m.item_name AS "itemName", m.entp_name AS "entpName", m.material_name AS "materialName", m.class_name AS "className", m.etc_otc_code AS "etcOtcCode", m.efficacy AS "efficacy", m.usage_dosage AS "usageDosage", m.edi_code AS "ediCode", m.is_discontinued AS "isDiscontinued", TO_CHAR(m.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt" FROM medications m ORDER BY m.item_name, m.medication_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.ingr_a_name AS "ingrAName", d.ingr_b_name AS "ingrBName", d.taboo_type AS "tabooType", d.taboo_effect AS "tabooEffect", d.age_base AS "ageBase", d.grade AS "grade", TO_CHAR(d.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt" FROM medication_interactions d )

SELECT DISTINCT d.ingr_a_name AS "ingrAName", d.ingr_b_name AS "ingrBName", d.taboo_type AS "tabooType", d.taboo_effect AS "tabooEffect", d.age_base AS "ageBase", d.grade AS "grade", TO_CHAR(d.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt" FROM medication_interactions d ORDER BY "tabooType", "ingrAName", "ingrBName", "grade", "ageBase", "tabooEffect", "updatedAt" OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
